conventions.anchors: third-colour neighbours of signed boundary ports
conventions.linked_cut_diagram: linked port diagram augmented by every live/dead transition endpoint on every cut backbone and its tau/third anchors
conventions.linked_port_diagram: canonical coloured relational graph of signed ports, tau links, third links, and alternating-backbone segments labelled by length and incident colours
conventions.local_rank_signature: multiset over opponent moves of the multiset of boundary ranks of every legal reply child
conventions.twist_radius: number of successive backbone layers added through tau and third-matching neighbours, with radius zero equal to every initially cut backbone
conventions.unlinked_word: the predecessor multiset of signed cyclic words, without tau links or third matching anchors
